from users.validate import validate_email


def import_users(csv_text: str) -> dict:
    """Import users from CSV text (see README)."""
    imported = []
    rejected = []
    seen_emails = set()

            # Blank line - skipped but still counted in numbering

        if email_lower in seen_emails:
            rejected.append({"line": line_no, "email": email, "reason": "duplicate"})
            continue

        imported.append({"name": name, "email": email_lower})
        seen_emails.add(email_lower)

    return {"imported": imported, "rejected": rejected}
